annotations.title: Create a Microsoft Advertising UET tag

description: Create a UET tag (Microsoft’s site tracking pixel) and get its install snippet, read back. Url / Event / Duration / PagesViewedPerVisit conversion goals, remarketing lists and conversion bidding all need one. Name ≤100 characters, unique per customer. Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

description.description: optional note on what the tag tracks

name.description: tag name, up to 100 characters, unique per customer
